Vegetarian Sausage and Marinara Pasta

Instructions

Ingredients:

  • Penne Pasta
  • Marinara Sauce
  • Vegetarian Sausage
  • Spinach
  • Garlic

Steps:

Cook Pasta: bring water in a pot to a boil, add a generous amount of salt, and add the pasta into the water for the amount of time instructed by the package. Cook sausage: cut the sausage into preferred slice thickness, add to a pan with olive oil at medium heat, flip to ensure both sides are evenly cooked. Tip! The sausage will continue to cook in the next step so avoid overcooking in this step! Cook sauce: add the marinara sauce, minced garlic, and spinach and stir until combined. Tip! Lower the pan heat to prevent splattering sauce! Combine the cooked pasta into the pan, mix, and serve on a plate.
